Iran summons Ukraine's chargé d'affaires over Caspian Sea vessel attack

Iran summoned Ukraine's chargé d'affaires on Saturday over an attack on an Iranian vessel in the Caspian Sea that killed one sailor and injured another. The Ukrainian President confirmed the strike, while Tehran vowed retaliation. Iran accused Ukraine of the attack, which occurred on Friday. One Iranian sailor was killed and another injured. The incident took place in the Caspian Sea.
